# SPEC T-303: in .lgo a constant product in a make length stays a
# constant, so the buffer is fixed-size and never reaches the heap; the
# same product of variables lowers to logos/rt.MulLen, takes the
# variable-size path, and allocates once it outgrows the 32-byte stack
# buffer at -O=1.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos test -count=1 -O=1 .

cd ../nested
logos run -p=1 .
stdout '^ok mullen-nested-and-capacity$'
logos eject -o out
grep 'MulLen\(len\(make\(\[\]struct\{\}, _logos_rt\.MulLen\(a, b,' out/main.go
grep 'MulLen\(.*\), c,' out/main.go
grep 'make\(\[\]struct\{\}, n, _logos_rt\.MulLen\(a, b,' out/main.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/makelenconst

go 1.27

-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- m/make.lgo --
package makelenconst

const rows = 8

var cols = 8

//go:noinline
func constProduct() byte {
	b := make([]byte, rows*8)
	b[0] = 3
	return b[63]
}

//go:noinline
func variableProduct() byte {
	b := make([]byte, rows*cols)
	b[0] = 3
	return b[63]
}

-- m/make_test.lgo --
package makelenconst

import "testing"

var sink byte

func TestConstProductStaysFixed(t *testing.T) {
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { sink = constProduct() }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("constant product make took %v allocations, want none", got)
	}
}

func TestVariableProductTakesChecked(t *testing.T) {
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { sink = variableProduct() }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("variable product make took %v allocations, want the variable-size path", got)
	}
}

-- nested/go.mod --
module example.com/mullennested

go 1.27

-- nested/main.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "fmt"

func nested(a, b, c int) int {
	return len(make([]struct{}, len(make([]struct{}, a*b))*c))
}

func capacity(n, a, b int) (int, int) {
	x := make([]struct{}, n, a*b)
	return len(x), cap(x)
}

func expectPanic(f func(), want string) {
	defer func() {
		if got := recover(); got != want {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("panic=%v want=%s", got, want))
		}
	}()
	f()
}

func main() {
	if got := nested(3, 4, 5); got != 60 {
		panic(got)
	}
	if n, c := capacity(1, 3, 4); n != 1 || c != 12 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("len=%d cap=%d", n, c))
	}
	max := int(^uint(0) >> 1)
	expectPanic(func() { nested(max, 2, 1) }, "logos: make length overflow: a * b")
	expectPanic(func() { nested(1, max, 2) }, "logos: make length overflow: len(make([]struct{}, a * b)) * c")
	expectPanic(func() { capacity(1, max, 2) }, "logos: make length overflow: a * b")
	fmt.Println("ok mullen-nested-and-capacity")
}
